name: chonk
description: Tells you when your Claude Code session has gotten too big, and offers a handoff to a fresh one.

nudge_at.title: First nudge at (live context tokens)
nudge_at.description: Live context size before the first wrap-up suggestion. Default 500000 — about half the 1M window, and the point that covers ~80% of spend in a 342-session sample. Lower it to catch more, raise it for fewer interruptions.

rearm_every.title: Re-arm every (tokens)
rearm_every.description: How much further growth before chonk speaks up again. Default 200000, so a long session gets reminded at 700K and 900K rather than once and never again.
